## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. For documentation-only changes, describe the link and content review.

## Screenshots or evidence

Include before/after screenshots for UI changes, or source/evaluation evidence for data/model changes. Remove this section when it does not apply.

## Release notes

Note any data refresh, environment change, limitation, or deployment consideration. Maintainer approval is required before merging or deploying.
